title: Sea lion pupping season is here!
description:
It's officially sea lion pupping season at La Jolla Cove! 💛

Help keep moms and pups safe by admiring them from a distance, staying quiet and never touching or feeding wildlife. 

Remember to follow all posted signs. Learn more at sandiego.gov/park-and-recreation/point-lajolla.
